## Current Design and Proposal

Start with the [system design](design.qmd), [MCU plan](mcu.qmd), [FPGA plan](fpga.qmd), and [hardware](hardware.qmd). The current plan uses FPGA position PI and MCU ADC/DMA.

| Document | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Proposal and specifications](docs/proposal.qmd) | Current commitments and source history |
| [Revised proposal PDF](overleaf_10mm/proposal.pdf) / [LaTeX](overleaf_10mm/proposal.tex) | Full proposal and architecture figure |
| [Calculation PDF](overleaf_10mm/calculation_summary.pdf) / [LaTeX](overleaf_10mm/calculation_summary.tex) | Lift model and continuous/sampled stability |
| [Overleaf ZIP](Magnetic_Levitation_Overleaf_10mm.zip) | Editable proposal, calculations, and figures |
| [Original Word proposal](Project%20Proposal.docx) | Earlier proposal retained for comparison |
| [Current checkoff record](docs/checkoff.qmd) | Demonstration commitments and evidence |
| [Results](results.qmd) | Dated checks and remaining measurements |

The November sensing discussion also informed the resolution section. Its 5 V ADC example is separate from the proposed 3.3 V circuit.

## SPI Bring-up

The [one-byte test guide](simple_byte/README.md) explains the standalone FPGA-to-MCU experiment and SEGGER Watch variable. Download [MCU main](simple_byte/main.c), [FPGA sender](simple_byte/spi_byte.sv), [constraints](simple_byte/spi_byte.pcf), and [testbench](simple_byte/tb_spi_byte.sv).
